parts.zh: W：你好，请坐。我这里有你的检查结果
M：那我为什么总是感觉这么不舒服？
W：这可能是过度劳累和压力造成的
M：不，不可能。我一直都很努力地工作
W：你刚才描述的情况很常见
M：对，实际上大多数日子都是这样
W：那并不代表什么。你可能在不知情的情况下承受了20年的压力
W：这些都是压力带来的常见后果

items.stem: What do we learn about the man from his test results?

choices.text: It is clear that he is expected to enjoy a healthy life.
choices.zh: 很明显他有望享有健康的生活。

choices.text: There is nothing wrong with his digestive system.
choices.zh: 他的消化系统没有任何问题。

choices.text: There is some indication of an issue with his blood circulation.
choices.zh: 有迹象表明他的血液循环存在问题。

choices.text: He doesn't know he has long been suffering from poor health.
choices.zh: 他不知道自己长期以来一直健康状况不佳。

items.stem: What does the woman think is a common phenomenon among many people?

choices.text: Mistaking symptoms of illness for stress.
choices.zh: 将疾病症状误认为是压力。

choices.text: Complaining they are being overworked.
choices.zh: 抱怨自己工作过度。

choices.text: Being unaware of the stress they are under.
choices.zh: 没有意识到自己所承受的压力。

choices.text: Suffering from illness without recognising it.
choices.zh: 患病却没有察觉。

items.stem: What does the woman say she will do for the man?

choices.text: Prescribe some medication for him.
choices.zh: 给他开一些药物。

choices.text: Give him another physical check-up.
choices.zh: 再给他做一次体检。

choices.text: Explain to him the common consequence of stress.
choices.zh: 向他解释压力的常见后果。

choices.text: Buy some sleeping pills for him from the drugstore.
choices.zh: 从药店为他购买一些安眠药。

items.stem: What does the man say about the industry he is engaged in?

choices.text: It calls for responsible management.
choices.zh: 它要求负责任的管理。

choices.text: It proves to be quite profitable.
choices.zh: 它被证明相当有利可图。

choices.text: It is remarkably promising.
choices.zh: 它非常有前景。

choices.text: It is full of competition.
choices.zh: 它充满竞争。

items.stem: Why did John Williams leave the sport of basketball at just 25?

choices.text: To avoid being in the limelight.
choices.zh: 为了避免成为公众关注的焦点。

choices.text: To seek medical help for his injury.
choices.zh: 为了寻求医疗帮助治疗他的伤病。

choices.text: To pursue a less competitive career.
choices.zh: 为了追求竞争性较小的职业。

choices.text: To stay away from his hostile teammates.
choices.zh: 为了远离充满敌意的队友。

items.stem: What does the man say about basketball as a career for most players?

choices.text: It has ups and downs.
choices.zh: 它有起有落。

choices.text: It proves rewarding.
choices.zh: 它被证明是有回报的。

choices.text: It does not last long.
choices.zh: 它持续的时间不长。

choices.text: It is not so profitable.
choices.zh: 它没有那么赚钱。

items.stem: What do we learn from the woman about John Williams 20 years later?

choices.text: He was a financial advisor.
choices.zh: 他是一名财务顾问。

choices.text: He suffered from poor health.
choices.zh: 他健康状况不佳。

choices.text: He became a basketball coach.
choices.zh: 他成为了一名篮球教练。

choices.text: He was back in the news.
choices.zh: 他重新出现在新闻中。

items.stem: What has the man spent the last two decades trying to do?

choices.text: Study issues of public health.
choices.zh: 研究公共卫生问题。

choices.text: Alleviate the obesity problem.
choices.zh: 缓解肥胖问题。

choices.text: Raise sufficient public funding.
choices.zh: 筹集足够的公共资金。

choices.text: Train young basketball players.
choices.zh: 训练年轻篮球运动员。

items.stem: When did Kate Atkinson begin to write for women's magazines?

choices.text: When she started teaching at Edinburgh University in Scotland.
choices.zh: 当她开始在苏格兰爱丁堡大学任教时。

choices.text: While she was doing her doctoral studies on American Literature.
choices.zh: 在她攻读美国文学博士学位期间。

choices.text: After publishing her first novel Behind the Scenes at the Museum.
choices.zh: 在出版她的第一部小说《博物馆幕后》之后。

choices.text: After winning the 1986 Woman's Own Short Story Competition.
choices.zh: 在赢得1986年《女性周刊》短篇小说大赛之后。

items.stem: What did Kate Atkinson's books touch on?

choices.text: The themes of love and loss.
choices.zh: 爱与失去的主题。

choices.text: The code of human behaviour.
choices.zh: 人类行为的准则。

choices.text: The sins and flaws of eccentrics.
choices.zh: 古怪之人的罪过和缺陷。

choices.text: The manners of fashionable circles.
choices.zh: 上流社会的礼仪。

items.stem: What do we learn about the clever and deceitful characters in a comedy of manners?

choices.text: They are usually ignorant of complex human relations.
choices.zh: 他们通常对复杂的人际关系一无所知。

choices.text: They successfully imitate the manners of celebrities.
choices.zh: 他们成功地模仿名人的举止。

choices.text: They often get rewarded instead of being punished.
choices.zh: 他们经常得到奖赏而不是受到惩罚。

choices.text: They are generally looked down upon in society.
choices.zh: 他们在社会上普遍受到轻视。

items.stem: Why does the speaker say adaptability is an important skill to exercise in the workplace?

choices.text: It is what members use to alleviate tension in a team.
choices.zh: 这是成员用来缓解团队紧张气氛的能力。

choices.text: It is what employers are increasingly seeking after.
choices.zh: 这是雇主日益寻求的能力。

choices.text: It is conducive to getting over a recession.
choices.zh: 这有助于度过经济衰退。

choices.text: It is necessary for learning a new task.
choices.zh: 这是学习新任务所必需的。

items.stem: What does adaptability enable us to do according to strategy consultant Dorie Clark?

choices.text: Make better choices.
choices.zh: 做出更好的选择。

choices.text: Follow innovative ideas.
choices.zh: 追随创新理念。

choices.text: Achieve recognition duly.
choices.zh: 及时获得认可。

choices.text: Accumulate work experience.
choices.zh: 积累工作经验。

items.stem: What do we learn about today's work culture from the passage?

choices.text: Workers show more emotional intelligence.
choices.zh: 员工表现出更高的情商。

choices.text: Workers use brains more than muscles.
choices.zh: 员工更多使用脑力而非体力。

choices.text: People usually work flexible hours.
choices.zh: 人们通常采用弹性工作时间。

choices.text: People often work in teams.
choices.zh: 人们经常以团队形式工作。

items.stem: What are employees with adaptability able to do when changes occur?

choices.text: Leave the group as soon as possible.
choices.zh: 尽快离开团队。

choices.text: Anticipate setbacks well in advance.
choices.zh: 提前充分预见挫折。

choices.text: Decide on new priorities speedily.
choices.zh: 迅速决定新的优先事项。

choices.text: Stick to original goals confidently.
choices.zh: 自信地坚持原有目标。

items.stem: What question does the speaker address in this talk?

choices.text: What differentiates people from animals.
choices.zh: 人与动物的区别是什么。

choices.text: Why philosophers disagree with scientists.
choices.zh: 哲学家为什么不同意科学家的观点。

choices.text: Where humans' great cognitive capacity originates.
choices.zh: 人类巨大的认知能力源于何处。

choices.text: When being creative becomes a biological mandate.
choices.zh: 创造力何时成为一种生物学上的必然要求。

items.stem: What does the speaker believe about innovation?

choices.text: It is what tells apart two adjacent generations.
choices.zh: 它是区分相邻两代人的标志。

choices.text: It is what sharpens our appetite for novelty.
choices.zh: 它是激发我们对新奇事物渴望的东西。

choices.text: It is something only geniuses can achieve.
choices.zh: 它是只有天才才能实现的事情。

choices.text: It is something every human being can do.
choices.zh: 它是每个人都能做到的事情。

items.stem: How does the human brain work according to the speaker?

choices.text: It seeks inspiration for novel inventions.
choices.zh: 它为新颖的发明寻找灵感。

choices.text: It constantly absorbs new information.
choices.zh: 它不断吸收新信息。

choices.text: It uses existing ideas to create new ones.
choices.zh: 它利用现有想法创造新想法。

choices.text: It repeats precedent on a regular basis.
choices.zh: 它定期重复先例。

items.stem: What view of many dog owners win support from researchers studying dog cognition?

choices.text: Dogs know when their owners are not feeling well.
choices.zh: 狗知道它们的主人身体不适。

choices.text: Dogs have the cognition for telling right from wrong.
choices.zh: 狗具有辨别是非的认知能力。

choices.text: Dogs have an aptitude for developing skills to interact with humans.
choices.zh: 狗具有发展与人类互动技能的天赋。

choices.text: Dogs know when their human companions can no longer stand them.
choices.zh: 狗知道它们的人类同伴何时无法再忍受它们。

items.stem: Why can dogs detect their owner's abnormal odor according to the speaker?

choices.text: They can readily detect different ill smells of viruses.
choices.zh: 它们能轻易探测到病毒的各种病态气味。

choices.text: They can easily tell what bacteria cause odor change.
choices.zh: 它们能容易地辨别出什么细菌导致气味变化。

choices.text: They are particularly sensitive to strange smells.
choices.zh: 它们对陌生气味特别敏感。

choices.text: They have an extremely powerful sense of smell.
choices.zh: 它们拥有极其强大的嗅觉。

items.stem: What does research suggest for now about dog ownership?

choices.text: It can ensure owners suffer fewer chronic diseases.
choices.zh: 它能确保主人较少患慢性疾病。

choices.text: It can benefit owners both physically and mentally.
choices.zh: 它能在身体和心理上使主人受益。

choices.text: It can reduce owners' risk of getting cancer or diabetes.
choices.zh: 它能降低主人患癌症或糖尿病的风险。

choices.text: It can alert owners to the seriousness of their conditions.
choices.zh: 它能提醒主人注意其病情的严重性。

items.stem: What does Onward's report propose ministers should do?

choices.text: Crack down on courses like science, technology, engineering and math.
choices.zh: 严厉打击科学、技术、工程和数学等课程。

choices.text: Restrict the ability of creative arts courses to recruit new students.
choices.zh: 限制创意艺术课程招收新生的能力。

choices.text: Look at how to reform technical and vocational education.
choices.zh: 研究如何改革技术和职业教育。

choices.text: Ensure creative arts students get better value for money.
choices.zh: 确保创意艺术专业学生获得更高的性价比。

items.stem: What does the speaker think of Onward's arguments?

choices.text: Seemingly reasonable.
choices.zh: 看似合理。

choices.text: Clearly well-grounded.
choices.zh: 明显有充分根据。

choices.text: Extremely irrational.
choices.zh: 极其不理性。

choices.text: Apparently simplistic.
choices.zh: 显然过于简单化。

items.stem: What do we learn about British college graduates five years after graduation?

choices.text: A high proportion of them haven't tried to save money.
choices.zh: 他们中很大比例没有试图存钱。

choices.text: Most of them never hope to buy a house or to retire.
choices.zh: 他们中的大多数从未希望买房或退休。

choices.text: Forty percent of them earn less than ￡25,000 a year.
choices.zh: 他们中40%的人年收入低于25,000英镑。

choices.text: The majority of them have fairly well-paying jobs.
choices.zh: 他们中的大多数拥有薪酬相当不错的工作。

items.stem: What does the speaker say actually accounts for the problem identified by Onward?

choices.text: The context of a bank balance.
choices.zh: 银行余额的背景。

choices.text: Britain's economy as a whole.
choices.zh: 英国整体经济。

choices.text: The specific degree a student earns.
choices.zh: 学生获得的具体学位。

choices.text: Britain's defective educational system.
choices.zh: 英国有缺陷的教育体系。
